thread:
Maya (docs): heads-up — while updating the autoscale playbook I found multiple references to the old 'scalePolicy.v1' schema. customers following examples will hit validation errors.
Diego (eng-ml): ugh. which examples?
Maya (docs): two places: /docs/dedicated/autoscale.md (examples section) and the provisioning quickstart snippet. also a YAML sample in the repo: docs/examples/autoscale-sample.yaml.
Lina (sdk): what's changed in the schema? I remember we flattened the policy fields and renamed 'max_burst' -> 'burst_capacity' in v2.
Maya (docs): exactly. current docs still show max_burst. validator on deploy-preview rejects the sample.
Diego (eng-ml): i can confirm the v2 schema mapping:
- scalePolicy.v1.max_burst -> scalePolicy.v2.burst_capacity
- scalePolicy.v1.cooldown_s -> scalePolicy.v2.cooldown_seconds
- policy_type: 'elastic' renamed to 'adaptive'
Maya (docs): perfect. can you post a tiny diff we can copy into the docs? also need a one-sentence migration note at top: "Note: scalePolicy schema v2 replaces v1; see mapping below."
Lina (sdk): i'll update the SDK examples to emit v2 by default and add a compatibility snippet showing how to translate v1 YAML to v2.
Maya (docs): i sketched a compatibility table and a short YAML before/after. adding here for review:
```yaml
# before (v1)
scalePolicy:
  policy_type: elastic
  max_burst: 5
  cooldown_s: 60

# after (v2)
scalePolicy:
  policy_type: adaptive
  burst_capacity: 5
  cooldown_seconds: 60
```
Diego (eng-ml): looks good. one nit: we should call out that 'adaptive' has a slightly different balancing algorithm — link to the tuning section.
Maya (docs): good call, i'll add a cross-link to #autoscale-tuning. also found two dead links in the same doc pointing to #preemption-behavior and #tenant-eviction which no longer exist after the refactor.
Lina (sdk): those anchors were collapsed into #eviction-model. best to add 301-style static redirects or update the anchor references inline.
Maya (docs): i'll update the doc references and add a small note to the changelog. created PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 (branch: docs/autoscale-schema-v2). includes YAML swaps, example updates, and a migration section. needs tech review and QA.
ops-bot: preview build ready: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs.net/501 — includes updated examples and new migration table. validator warnings: docs/examples/autoscale-sample.yaml line 12: unknown field 'max_burst'
Lina (sdk): i'll push a quick commit to the branch to change that sample to v2.
Diego (eng-ml): can someone add a short paragraph under 'Dedicated capacity' about how scalePolicy interacts with reserved pools (bursting vs reserved capacity)? customers ask and it's not clear.
Maya (docs): adding that now. wording draft: "Reserved pools allocate committed capacity; scalePolicy controls temporary burst behavior and autoscale decisions. Burst_capacity allows short-term oversubscription but remains bounded by pool limits." please sanity-check.
Diego (eng-ml): that's accurate; maybe add a reference to the SLO table for eviction-risk when bursting.
Maya (docs): done. Lina, once you push the sample fix i'll flag @Diego for a quick review and we can merge.
Lina (sdk): pushed commit fixing sample and added compatibility snippet for users stuck on v1. PR updated. requested review from @Diego and @Maya.
Maya (docs): merged after Diego's quick review. published. closing thread. Thanks!
